newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE January wheat falls by A$1.00 a tonne.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE January wheat falls by A$1.00 a tonne.

text.p: Nearby January wheat futures traded A$1.00 lower to settle at A$162.50 a tonne on volume of just one 50-tonne lot.

Grain traders said concern that growers would have difficulty getting some grains to ports in New South Wales state due to rail industrial action diminished after the action reportedly had little impact on shipments.

A 24-hour ban on rostering of locomotives for grains shipments in New South Wales that ended earlier on Tuesday caused only minor disruptions to wheat shipments, a spokesman for the state's rail transport system told Reuters.
